title: 第3章 魔王不靠谱第4章 我独自升级
slug: 我妈等着治病你召唤我当勇者
content_zh:
“让我回去！现在！立刻！马上！”
林默的理智在听到殷血那嚣张的笑声时彻底崩断。
他猛地踏前一步，伸手精准地一把将悬浮在空中的小魔王攥在了手里。
那巴掌大小的身躯在他沾满鲜血的手掌中显得如此脆弱。
林默几乎是用尽了全身的力气，疯狂地摇晃着手臂。
殷血像个小布偶般被甩得头晕眼花，翅膀都耷拉了下来。
“咳……放……放手！”
殷血被掐得小脸通红，四肢乱蹬，艰难地拍打着林默的手指。
“有……有办法回去！我说有办法！”
最后那句话，瞬间浇熄了林默部分失控的怒火。
他动作一顿，松开了手。
殷血啪叽一声掉在地上，捂着脖子剧烈地咳嗽起来。
小翅膀无力地扇动着：“咳咳……”
林默居高临下，眼神冰冷得像两块寒铁：“说！什么办法？如果你再敢骗我……”
“我没骗你这次！”
殷血缓过气，虽然依旧不满，但语气收敛了不少。
她飞起来一些，保持在一个林默伸手够不到的安全距离。
“我既然是魔王，巅峰时期可是能跟神明掰手腕的存在！撕裂空间，送你回原来的世界，理论上当然可以做到！”
“你？”林默毫不掩饰自己的怀疑，目光扫过她这迷你的身躯。
“就你现在这样，有什么实力？”

殷血的脸瞬间涨红，像是被踩到了尾巴：“那是因为我刚复活！灵魂还被分割封印在各地的教堂！这只是我微不足道的一小部分！等我恢复全部力量……”
“需要多久？”
林默打断她，直接问出最关键的问题。
殷血歪着头，装模作样地想了想：“嗯……按部就班的升级的话，大概也就几百年吧？运气好，可能三百年就够了。”
“几百年？！”
林默的眼睛瞬间又红了，上前一步作势又要抓她。
“等等等等！”
殷血吓得连忙后退，翅膀急速扇动。
“那是正常情况！笨办法！还有个捷径！”
她飞快地说道：“只要你跟我建立灵魂连接，我们就能共享力量！你变强，我的恢复速度也会跟着加快！这叫双赢！”
林默强迫自己再次冷静下来，盯着她：“那需要多久？我要一个具体的目标！”
殷血见他有谈下去的意思，胆子又大了些。
飞近一点，嘿嘿一笑：“这就看你自己的本事了。听着，只要你的等级提升到20级，我就能帮你看一眼你原来的世界，如果你的等级能超过100级，我就能短暂地撕裂空间，让你回去待上一小段时间！”
说到这她似乎是看出了林默眼里的怀疑，连忙伸出两根手指指着天起誓：“我发誓这次没有骗你，只要咱俩灵魂连接之后你就知道了。”
林默看着她的模样皱眉思索。
看一眼……短暂回去……
这总算有一线希望。
这么想着，他仔细审视着眼前这个自称魔王的小不点：“那你为什么要骗我杀人？”
殷血耸了耸肩，难得露出点正经的表情：“我之前被勇者给打败了，灵魂被教会那些该死的神仆封印在了大陆各地的教堂里。”
content_en:
"Let me go back! Now! Immediately! Immediately!"
Lin Mo's reason was completely shattered when he heard Yin Xue's arrogant laughter.
He took a sudden step forward, reached out and accurately grasped the little devil suspended in the air in his hand.
The palm-sized body looked so fragile in his blood-stained palms.
Lin Mo almost exhausted all his strength and shook his arms crazily.
Yin Xue was thrown around like a little rag doll, so dizzy that his wings drooped.
"Ahem... let go... let go!"
Yin Xue's face turned red from being pinched, and he kicked his limbs wildly, slapping Lin Mo's fingers with difficulty.
"There is... there is a way to go back! I said there is a way!"
That last sentence instantly extinguished some of Lin Mo's out-of-control anger.
He made a movement and let go of his hand.
Yin Xue fell to the ground with a clatter, and he covered his neck and coughed violently.
The little wings flapped feebly: "Ahem..."
Lin Mo was condescending, his eyes as cold as two pieces of cold iron: "Tell me! What can I do? If you dare to lie to me again..."
"I didn't lie to you this time!"
Yin Xue calmed down, and although he was still dissatisfied, his tone became much calmer.
She flew up a little, keeping a safe distance out of Lin Mo's reach.
"Since I am the Demon King, I was a being who could compete with gods at my peak! I can tear apart space and send you back to your original world. In theory, of course it can be done!"
"You?" Lin Mo didn't hide his suspicion, his eyes swept over her mini body.
"As you are now, what strength do you have?"
Yin Xue's face turned red instantly, as if he had been stepped on: "That's because I have just been resurrected! My soul has been divided and sealed in churches everywhere! This is only a small and insignificant part of me! When I regain all my strength..."
"How long will it take?"
Lin Mo interrupted her and asked the most critical question directly.
Yin Xue tilted his head and pretended to think for a while: "Hmm... If we upgrade step by step, it will only take a few hundred years, right? With luck, maybe three hundred years will be enough."
"Hundreds of years?!"
Lin Mo's eyes instantly turned red again, and he took a step forward to catch her again.
"Wait wait wait!"
Yin Xue was so frightened that he quickly backed away and flapped his wings rapidly.
"That's normal! Stupid way! There's a shortcut!"
She said quickly: "As long as you establish a soul connection with me, we can share power! As you become stronger, my recovery speed will also speed up! This is called a win-win!"
Lin Mo forced himself to calm down again and stared at her: "How long will it take? I want a specific goal!"
Seeing that he was interested in continuing the conversation, Yin Xue became bolder.
He flew closer and smiled: "It all depends on your ability. Listen, as long as your level reaches level 20, I can help you take a look at your original world. If your level can exceed level 100, I can temporarily tear apart the space and let you go back for a short period of time!"
Speaking of this, she seemed to see the suspicion in Lin Mo's eyes, and quickly pointed two fingers at the sky and swore: "I swear I didn't lie to you this time. You will know as soon as our souls are connected."
Lin Mo looked at her and frowned in thought.
Take a look...go back briefly...
There is finally a glimmer of hope.
With this in mind, he carefully examined the little guy in front of him who claimed to be the Demon King: "Then why did you lie to me to kill someone?"
Yin Xue shrugged, rarely showing a serious expression: "I was defeated by the brave before, and my soul was sealed in churches across the continent by the damn servants of the church."
